subject: variable: remove `StrictSQLMode` in `variable.SessionVars` (#50624)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent in the scoped modules. Change is a mechanical removal of `SessionVars.StrictSQLMode` (previously a mirror of `SQLMode.HasStrictMode()`), updating strict-mode checks to derive from `SessionVars.SQLMode` and replacing temporary session-var mutation with `table.GetColOriginDefaultValueWithoutStrictSQLMode()` for default-value fetching. No plausible remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, session/txn behavior, or runtime handling; later history up to `upstream/master` shows no subsequent fix indicating a missed High/Blocker.
